userStories.title: Migration runner with transactional semantics
acceptanceCriteria: A new praxis/storage/migrations/ directory holds numbered *.sql files; profile_store.py runs every file in lexical order on init, wrapping each in BEGIN; ... COMMIT; and inserting one row into schema_migrations(version, applied_at) inside the same transaction.
schema_migrations is created on first run as (version TEXT PRIMARY KEY, applied_at TEXT NOT NULL); on the second init no migration re-runs.

A migration whose SQL raises sqlite3.OperationalError triggers ROLLBACK, leaves schema_migrations empty for that version, re-raises, and the next invocation re-attempts the same version (idempotent at fully-applied granularity).
Typecheck passes: uv run mypy praxis
Tests pass: uv run pytest

userStories.title: follow_ups columns + active-commitment unique index
acceptanceCriteria: A migration adds user_chosen INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, display_text TEXT, and superseded_by INTEGER REFERENCES follow_ups(id) to follow_ups.
A partial-unique index idx_follow_ups_one_active_per_week on follow_ups(week_iso) WHERE outcome='pending' AND superseded_by IS NULL is created.

Inserting a second row for the same week_iso with outcome='pending' and superseded_by IS NULL raises sqlite3.IntegrityError; inserting it after the first row's superseded_by has been set to a newer id succeeds.
Typecheck passes: uv run mypy praxis
Tests pass: uv run pytest

userStories.title: session_reflections table
acceptanceCriteria: A migration creates session_reflections with id PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, session_stable_id TEXT NOT NULL, follow_up_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES follow_ups(id), self_report TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (self_report IN ('yes','no','partial','skip')), note TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, and the index idx_reflections_follow_up on follow_up_id.
Inserting with self_report='maybe' raises sqlite3.IntegrityError; inserting with note=NULL succeeds.
Insertion helper insert_session_reflection(...) is exposed on profile_store.py and writes ISO-8601 UTC timestamps for created_at.
Typecheck passes: uv run mypy praxis
Tests pass: uv run pytest

userStories.title: session_scores aug_auto columns
acceptanceCriteria: A migration adds aug_auto_classification TEXT and aug_auto_confidence REAL columns to session_scores.
A read helper on profile_store.py returns the classification + confidence for a given session and returns (None, None) for rows written before the migration ran.
Inserting aug_auto_classification with a value outside {'augmentation','automation','mixed'} via the Python write helper raises ValueError before any SQL is issued.
Typecheck passes: uv run mypy praxis
Tests pass: uv run pytest
